notes: וְהוּא בֶּן־אִישׁ מִצְרִי is recast as whose father was an Egyptian: rule 17 puts the relative on the explicit pronoun and leaves the waw unrepresented, and rule 30's generic-head-noun clause fuses אִישׁ מִצְרִי into the one word Egyptian, headed on the gentilic.
The second construct chain writes a the before both members, so nothing is fronted and rule 29's arthrous-rectum count places each; the substantival gentilic keeps the generic woman under rule 31.
The article on הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי is unrepresented, the ASV writing a man of Israel with no the (rule 29).
